start: Menu, Enquiries ('People who asked about joining')

user_sees: Sheet 'Add enquiry': 'Name', 'Code', 'Mobile number', 'Interested in (optional)', 'Where did they hear about us? (optional)', 'Follow-up date' with the hint 'No date: it goes under Later.'
must_not: The button live while offline

steps.action: Fill it with a follow-up date and save
user_sees: The person in the list with 'Call back on <day>' and Call, WhatsApp, make-member, follow-up and not-interested buttons
must_not: Two enquiries from one save

start: Enquiries, a row, the follow-up button

user_sees: Sheet 'Call <name> again' with quick days and 'Or pick a date'
must_not: A past day accepted

steps.action: Save with no date, then with a past date, then a good date
user_sees: 'Pick a date.'
'The follow-up date can't be in the past.'
The row moves to its new day
must_not: The old date kept with no message

start: Enquiries, a row, the make-member button

steps.action: Tap it for a new number
user_sees: The new-member form filled with the name and number
must_not: The enquiry left open after the member is saved without a word ('The member was saved, but the enquiry was not closed.' must show if so)

steps.action: Tap it for a number that is already a member
user_sees: 'Already a member': '<name> is already a member with <number>.'; for an archived one 'Already a member (archived)' with a restore-and-link button
must_not: A second member with the same number

steps.action: Type a number that already asked
user_sees: '<name> already asked from this number (call back <day>). You can still save.'
must_not: A silent duplicate

user_sees: '<name> is already a member with this number.'
must_not: The warning naming a member of another gym

user_sees: Pill 'Not interested' and 'Why did <name> not join? (optional)'
must_not: The enquiry deleted

user_sees: The enquiry back under its follow-up day, the reason cleared
must_not: The old reason still counted in 'Where enquiries came from'

start: Enquiries, a joined friend who was invited by a member

user_sees: Sheet 'Thank <member>' and then 'Free days added'; or 'There are no free days to give for this friend.'
must_not: Free days added twice for the same friend

start: Enquiries, a row with a number

user_sees: The phone dialler or WhatsApp opens on that number; nothing is sent by itself
Web page rows show 'Asked on your web page' or 'Chat on your web page' with the whole chat
must_not: A message sent without the desk typing it; enquiries of another branch
